data.one_liner: Simple and fast QR code and Barcode generator and scanner with smartphones.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools to generate QR codes and barcodes. Also enables scanning them using smartphones.
use_when: You need to display QR codes or barcodes in your Flutter app.
You need to scan barcodes or QR codes on mobile or web.
avoid_when: You need an advanced machine learning barcode scanner with custom overlay features.
You require extensive customization not exposed by the package APIs.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Simple and fast implementation for both generation and scanning.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and examples provided in the README.
Specific native configuration and permission requirements are not documented in the text.
